subject: Future Tech
title: Edge Cases: The Long Tail
description: A 60-second lesson on Edge Cases: The Long Tail.

hook.text: A mattress falls off a truck. A child chases a ball into the street. Rare events are infinite in variety.

buildup.text: AVs handle 99% of driving easily. It's the remaining 1%—bizarre, unprecedented scenarios—that's the hardest to solve.

discovery.text: The long tail means thousands of unique edge cases. Each one requires the AI to generalize from limited experience.

twist.text: You can't test for events you've never imagined.

climax.text: Companies use generative AI to create novel edge cases, training the driving AI on scenarios no human ever imagined.

punchline.text: Driving is easy until it's not. The last 1% takes 99% of the effort.

quiz.question: What is 'the long tail' in autonomous vehicle development?
options: The queue of cars behind a slow AV
